name: Mizuno Kaoru
source: Kaoru is Kazuhiko's childhood friend. She stops by his home most days to walk him to school even though they're in different classes. She's the volleyball ace striker in the volleyball club.  She's absolutely in love with Kazuhiko and perfectly willing to have sex with him. She doesn't want to become pregnant however so she insists on contraception and sex while she's ovulating is absolutely forbidden.
